aggregation.sd: sample SD (n - 1); null when fewer than two seeds
aggregation.collapsed_runs: included (a class with Dice < 0.05 counts as collapsed)
aggregation.missing_or_failed: excluded and listed under problems; never counted as zero

note: rows flagged invariant_by_construction: the offset is added before the per-image z-score of the network input, which removes any constant; an unchanged Dice there is a property of the preprocessing
